confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sarajevo's price level, not checked against live menus or booking sites. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are the more reliable. Cocktail and wine are less certain. Hostel and hotel anchors are the least certain, and July is peak season, so these reflect summer rates. The BAM-to-USD basis assumes the currency peg to the euro and a EUR/USD rate near 1.16.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized Balkan capital with a moderate tourist market, similar to Mostar, Podgorica and Skopje, and below Zagreb, Ljubljana and Belgrade for accommodation. Drink prices are set relative to local beer prices, since direct knowledge of cocktail and wine prices is weaker.
